An '''intravenous sugar-solution drip''' was used to provide patients with [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]]. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] in [[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trances]] could be hooked up to a sugar-solution drip to prevent starvation and extend the trance to last a [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="RPG" />
